block-guide:
CORE/COLUMNS (+ core/column) Content side by side: text next to an image, two to four features in a row. Equal cards that should wrap are simpler as a group with {"layout":{"type":"grid"}}. REQUIRED STRUCTURE core/columns holds only core/column blocks; core/column stands only inside core/columns. Each column holds any blocks. Both have HTML: the columns
wraps the column
s. MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Main text

The wider column.

The narrow column, centred vertically.

WIDTHS A column without width shares the free space equally with the other such columns. width is a string with a unit: "33.33%", "240px", "12rem" -> style="flex-basis:". Keep the percentages of one row at 100 in total; the columns shrink to make room for the gap. OPTIONS isStackedOnMobile (default true): below 782px wide every column takes a full row. false -> class is-not-stacked-on-mobile: the columns stay side by side on phones. verticalAlignment on core/columns: top|center|bottom -> are-vertically-aligned-; on one core/column top|center|bottom|stretch -> is-vertically-aligned-. Gap: style.spacing.blockGap {"top":…,"left":…} (left = between columns, top = between stacked rows); no inline style in the saved HTML. align "wide" | "full" on core/columns -> alignwide / alignfull. PITFALLS Never write is-layout-* or wp-container-* classes: WordPress adds them when it renders. Colours, padding, border: see the theme settings rules in block-discovery-contract. CHECK Reopen the editor (no invalid notice); look at the front at desktop and below 782px.
